context.title: The Passover
context.summary: God gives instructions for the Passover lamb and unleavened bread; at midnight the firstborn of Egypt die, homes marked with blood are passed over, and Pharaoh sends Israel out in haste.
context.background: This month becomes the first of Israel's year (v. 2), called Abib (13:4), in spring. The meal is eaten dressed for travel, 'in haste' (v. 11). About 600,000 men leave, plus families and 'a mixed multitude' (vv. 37–38).

customs.note: A small bushy plant used like a brush to sprinkle or smear liquid. It reappears in purification rites and at the cross (John 19:29).
Bread made without leaven (yeast starter). It recalls a departure too quick for dough to rise (v. 39), and removing leaven became a yearly ritual.

watchFor: 'When I see the blood, I will pass over you' (v. 13).
Not a bone of the lamb is to be broken (v. 46).

people.name: Moses
people.summary: Drawn (or Egypt. mesu, “son;” hence Rameses, royal son). On the invitation of Pharaoh (Gen. 45:17-25), Jacob and his sons went down into Egypt.

people.name: Aaron
people.summary: The eldest son of Amram and Jochebed, a daughter of Levi (Ex. 6:20). Some explain the name as meaning mountaineer, others mountain of strength, illuminator.

people.name: Israel
people.summary: One who follows on another’s heels; supplanter, (Gen. 25:26; 27:36; Hos. 12:2-4), the second born of the twin sons of Isaac by Rebekah. He was born probably at Lahai-roi, when his father was fifty-nine and Abraham one hundred and fifty-nine years old.

people.name: Pharaoh
people.summary: The Pharaoh of the Exodus was probably Menephtah I., the fourteenth and eldest surviving son of Rameses II. He resided at Zoan, where he had the various interviews with Moses and Aaron recorded in the book of Exodus.

places.name: Egypt
places.summary: The land of the Nile and the pyramids, the oldest kingdom of which we have any record, holds a place of great significance in Scripture.

places.name: Rameses
places.summary: “the land of” (Gen. 47:11), was probably “the land of Goshen” 45:10.

places.name: Succoth
places.summary: The first encampment of the Israelites after leaving Ramesses (Ex. 12:37); the civil name of Pithom.

events.title: Exodus from Egypt
events.summary: Passage: Exodus 6:7–13:17. People: Moses, Aaron. Place: Egypt.

events.title: Sojourn in Canaan and Egypt
events.summary: Passage: Exodus 12:40 – Galatians 3:17. People: Abraham, Sarah, Lot, Pharaoh. Place: Egypt. Lasted about 430 years.
